svg.title: Antarctic Slope Current: a reported dated narrow-jet constraint
svg.desc: Less than 28 km on 23 February 2009, in the 100 m detided LADCP context near Riiser-Larsenisen. A narrow southwestward jet within broader flow. Representative width, lower bound and error unknown. Original PDF, figure pixels and paired edges unavailable; primary publisher indexed text reviewed. No zero-to-28 interval, confidence guarantee or annual range.

g.text: Author's reported constraint; no point width or lower bound.
Narrow southwestward jet, embedded in broader southwestward flow.
Peak 28 cm/s and background about 10 cm/s are not edge cutoffs.
3000 m is bottom topography, not observation depth.
No zero-to-28 interval, confidence guarantee, width band or annual range.
Source: Chavanne et al. (2010), DOI 10.1029/2010GL043603, Observations paragraph 5.
Primary publisher indexed text/captions read; original PDF and figure pixels unavailable.
Independent OSW graphic; source field and paired width edges not reproduced.
